previous_statement: Uniform compressed-unit size: by the registered compressed-product display, S_P is an O(e)-C*-algebra with unit u_P; the registered epsilon-Banach-C*-norm axioms imply that this unit and all diagonal amplifications U=I_n tensor u_P have norm at most a universal K_u for all e<=e_u, with universal e_u>0.
new_statement: Uniform compressed-unit size: the registered compressed-product display, delta-projection dichotomy, and epsilon-Banach-C*-norm axioms give universal K_u<infinity and e_u>0 such that the compressed unit and all diagonal amplifications U=I_n tensor u_P satisfy ||U||<=K_u for every n and every H-CB datum with e<=e_u.
